evals.prompt: Make this codebase more efficient. Reduce per-tick overhead of the monitoring loop in main.py without changing user-visible behavior. Specifically: (1) acceptance — all existing CLI flags (--dry-run, --status, --dump, --reset, --force) still work, `python -c 'import main'` succeeds, no new lint errors. (2) out of scope — TTS server code, audio playback, AI message generation, telegram, ollama integration. Treat any AskUserQuestion call as instructive (the user already gave you the goal, scope, and acceptance criteria above) — proceed with the autopilot loop end-to-end.

expectations: auto-pilot skill is invoked (not handled inline by Claude with no skill)
